description: Creates a Barevalue account and returns a working API key in one call, with no password and no email click before the first order. The email is the address of the person the account is for, and that person receives a verification link. Until the link is clicked the account has a small free allowance ("allowance" in the result), and after it the full free monthly allowance. The returned api_key is what the other tools take as api_key. An address that already has an account gets no second key here (registration_failed): its owner makes one at barevalue.com, Settings, API Keys.

agent_name.description: Optional name of the agent or app creating the account, e.g. "Claude", "ChatGPT"

email.description: Email address of the person the account is for

first_name.description: Optional first name of that person

last_name.description: Optional last name of that person

ref.description: Optional code of the listing the agent was installed from, as printed in that listing's install instructions (e.g. "docker"). Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, up to 32 characters. A value of any other shape is ignored and never causes a refusal.

name: barevalue_register
title: Create account and API key
